name: Robot Mutiny
description: Every BattleBot troop galaxy-wide is wired to one hidden transmitter on a ruin world. Robot garrisons quietly build hidden sleeper robots. When the broadcast wakes, colonies rise wherever their robots can win; the first captured colony makes the machines a full empire, and the transmitter spawns warships a tech level ahead of the best empire until it is silenced. Beacon fleet sizes (100/200/300) are tuned for large galaxies: lower the scale for small ones.
